description: In the final installment of TimesofIndia.com's series looking back at India's medal-winning campaigns at the Chess Olympiad in Samarkand, Savitha Shri opens up about her remarkable breakthrough as India's only individual gold medallist. The 19-year-old recalls arriving as a reserve, playing all 10 rounds and delivering when India needed her most, while discussing her family's sacrifices, the team's bronze, Swayams Mishra's support and her goal of becoming a Grandmaster.

title: Messi's emotional farewell ends in 1 goal, 2 assists and 3-0 win for Argentina
description: Lionel Messi’s emotional Argentina farewell ended in a 3-0 victory over Benin at the Monumental. After an extraordinary pre-match tribute, Messi assisted Nicolás Otamendi’s opener and Nico Paz’s curling finish before scoring a penalty himself. He came close again late on, hitting the post, before sending a final free-kick over the bar as Argentina celebrated a memorable night.

title: Iyer breaks Kohli's captaincy record: captain; Babar Azam still ahead
description: Shreyas Iyer smashed an unbeaten 102 off 43 balls against the West Indies in Lucknow, becoming the first Indian captain to score a T20I century while chasing. He surpassed Virat Kohli’s previous record of 94. Iyer is now India’s third captain with a T20I hundred, while Pakistan’s Babar Azam remains the global record-holder with 122.

title: ‘10 years of your leadership have been fantastic’: Mandhana’s message for Harman
description: Smriti Mandhana has succeeded Harmanpreet Kaur as the captain of the Indian women's cricket team. Harmanpreet's leadership spanned a decade and included significant achievements like two Asian Games gold medals. Mandhana previously led the team in several T20Is and ODIs before her full-time appointment. She aims to continue building on the successes of her predecessor while leading the white-ball formats.

title: ‘When are you going to play him?’: Ex-batter questions decision to bench Nitish
description: Aakash Chopra voiced his concerns regarding India's choice to omit Nitish Kumar Reddy from the first T20I lineup. Celebrating Naman Dhir's stellar bowling against the West Indies, he pointed out the unfortunate shortcomings of the opposing batting order. With Shai Hope and Sherfane Rutherford providing some resistance, their contributions were not enough, and India triumphed with an eight-wicket victory, taking a 1-0 series lead.

title: ‘Thank you for making me love football’: Neymar’s heartfelt message to Messi
description: Neymar Jr took a moment to thank Lionel Messi after the latter's heartfelt farewell match with the Argentine national team, which saw Messi light up the field with one goal and two assists for an audience of 85,000 fans. With a storied international career culminating in numerous accolades, including a World Cup title, Messi addressed the crowd, reassuring them of his ongoing support for Argentina's future.

title: ‘Greatest pile of mediocrity’: Hayden goes off over ‘disrespecting cricket’
description: Matthew Hayden has expressed strong concerns regarding the Australian national selection panel's decision to bring Nic Maddinson back into the fold for the upcoming series against South Africa. Maddinson, who hasn't participated in any first-class matches since early 2025, brings up worries about the standards of player selection. Hayden insists that those with more robust first-class records deserve priority, citing upcoming talents like Sam Harper as more deserving options.

title: Ronaldo explains Portugal exit: Star details broken promises; vows return
description: Cristiano Ronaldo has revealed why he left Portugal’s camp, claiming Jorge Jesus broke promises over his playing time and then contradicted their private agreement publicly. Ronaldo said the situation left him feeling unwanted and that continuing would harm the team. He apologised for leaving, accepted responsibility for his actions and insisted he remains available to compete for Portugal after his suspension.

Gardner admitted she was “naive” about how public the situation would become and said her reputation had been “tarnished”. She acknowledged Wright’s perspective, reflected on the difficult period and said her focus is now on moving forward.

title: The Asiad champs who made limited govt support count
description: India's remarkable performance, securing 21 gold medals at the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games, showcases the extraordinary talent of athletes who triumphed largely on meager resources. Archers Kumkum Mohod and Sahil Jadhav exemplify this feat, earning a mere Rs 50,000 through the Target Olympic Podium Scheme (TOPS). Their success story, alongside other boxers and sailors, underscores the determination to succeed amidst financial constraints, highlighting athletes' potential to shine even with limited support.

title: Shreyas Iyer's maiden T20I century powers India to eight-wicket win over West Indies

This remarkable innings paved the way for India's eight-wicket triumph over West Indies. Debutant Naman Dhir made a mark too, claiming three wickets as the Windies were limited to 171 runs. India now leads the series 1-0, showcasing their prowess in both batting and bowling.

His rebound made him only the second Indian scorer against Uruguay, joining Manas Bhattacharya, who struck in 1982. For Thapa, the landmark goal also marked his first international strike since 2023.

BCCI secretary Devajit Saikia specified that Laxman's aim was to ensure better communication about player fitness and availability, a crucial step as the team prepares for their imminent tour of New Zealand.

Messi's international career has been historic, leading Argentina to several achievements, including the World Cup victory.

title: Why Dybala and Molina are blocked from Messi’s farewell despite 2022 squad invite
